decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the firm's core agency-focused service and its 24/7 expert support, so the firm can interpret results and refine the offer with knowledge it already holds.

The version management tool builds on the firm's own software development and its existing tool suite (security center, recovery manager), so in-house R&D lets it assimilate feedback and keep improving the tool.

A legal data-processing contract generator lies far from the firm's hosting know-how, which limits its ability to learn from early results, so the resources are better redirected to the core platform.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's core competence, is backed by its owned data center and its R&D, and was prominently placed on the home page, making it a strategic keeper.
